subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

I was __happy __to know that Sheila passed her final exams.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sad**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"happy"** means feeling or showing pleasure or contentment. (खुश)

 
 
• **Example: **She was happy to see her family after a long time.
 
 
 
• **"Sad" **refers to feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy. (दुखी)
 
 
• **Example: **He felt sad when he heard the bad news.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'happy' **is **'sad'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Sad**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Joyful **(आनंदित): Feeling, expressing, or causing great pleasure and happiness.

 
 
• **Example:** The joyful children played in the park.
 
 
 
• **Upbeat **(उत्साही): Cheerful, optimistic.
 
 
• **Example: **She was feeling upbeat about her job interview.
 
 
 
• **Excited** (उत्साहित): Very enthusiastic and eager.
 
 
• **Example:** The kids were excited about the upcoming vacation.
